time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*fps)
units: pixels of the original 3840x2160 frame, origin top-left, x right, y down; seconds
description: Close top-down (somewhat oblique) handheld-or-fixed view of an airport baggage carousel. Grey metal carousel plates with embossed logos fill the background; bags ride the carousel left -> right across the frame for the whole clip. No static background is visible, nobody appears, nothing is thrown or bounces.

camera.motion: cannot be separated from the belt: every visible surface (plates, rubber panels, bags) rides the carousel. No fixed reference exists in view. Global similarity fit frame to frame: rotation |rot| < 0.25 deg/frame (mostly < 0.06), scale 0.99-1.01, i.e. no visible zoom/rotation. Treat camera as static unless a question says otherwise.
camera.global_motion_file: scene/global_motion.csv (per-frame median image shift of all tracked features, px/frame; cumulative shift)
camera.perspective: STRONG depth effects despite the 2D label. Image speed depends on position and on height above the belt (scene/speed_map.json): belt plates in the upper band (y<~1000) move ~45-50 px/frame (down to ~37 at the top-right corner), the lower band / bag tops (y>~1100) ~70-82 px/frame. Raised bag tops move faster than the belt beside them (black hard case top ~64 vs belt ~48 at the same y). Different points of one bag differ by up to ~5-7 % (e.g. backpack logo 66-70 vs buckle 72-77 px/frame; orange suitcase tag 71-79 vs handle 69-75). Upper-right of frame is farthest.
camera.lens: 4K wide-ish phone footage, mild motion blur (~10-30 px streaks) on every frame

carousel_plates.what: grey overlapping metal plates of the carousel, seam lines run roughly top-to-bottom (tilted), each plate carries one embossed oval logo near y~750
carousel_plates.plate_pitch_px: ~625 (autocorrelation of logo row y 550-950, frames 0/3/6: 627, 621, 620 px); visual logo spacing ~640 px at f0 (logos at x~500,1140,1790,2440,3060, y~750)
carousel_plates.speed_band: upper band moves ~46-50 px/frame (slower toward the right)

rubber_panels.what: dark ribbed rubber panels between plates in the lower band (e.g. f0: x 0-520 and 2840-3300, y 1220-2160)

blue_backpack.describe: large blue-and-light-grey hiking backpack (white 'deuter' logo), lying horizontally with its dark/black top end to the LEFT, grey strap tip sticking out left; lower half of frame
blue_backpack.visible_frames: 0 - ~46 (track rows 0-42; leading right end leaves frame at f10)
blue_backpack.ref_point: buckle on grey hip strap (template f0-22), continued by LK box shift f23-42
blue_backpack.reliability: x extents +-30 px; bottom never visible

red_suitcase.describe: red suitcase at the top-right corner, only a corner visible, on a dark area (shadow / dark bag)
red_suitcase.track: scene/tracks/red_suitcase.csv (red colour mask, visible part only)
red_suitcase.note: left edge moves ~40-44 px/frame (far, top-right region); full size never visible

orange_suitcase.describe: orange/brown leather-look suitcase lying flat, carry handle (black housing with tan grip) at its RIGHT (leading) end, wheels/feet at the left end, white-framed luggage ID tag on its top face; middle-lower band
orange_suitcase.ref_point: centre of the white luggage ID tag (template f25-69), continued with LK box shift f8-24 and f70-89
orange_suitcase.fully_in_view_frames: ~40/48 - 57 (trailing wheel housing x>0 from ~f40 by the box; orange body x>0 from ~f47; handle reaches right border f58)
orange_suitcase.reliability: edges +-20-40 px (motion blur ~30 px); which length a question means is ambiguous - record gives overall (2455), body only (2090), body+grip (2348)

black_hard_case.describe: large black hard-shell suitcase lying flat, rotated (its long edge tilted), occupying the top band; two silver wheel hubs visible near its right end
black_hard_case.ref_point: lower silver wheel hub (template f23-76; at f40 (1400,810)), continued by LK shift
black_hard_case.extents: never fully in view (most of it is above/left/right of the frame); the full_* box in its csv is only a loose region, NOT its size. Wheel hub separation f40: lower (1400,810) to upper (1710,250) = 640 px.
black_hard_case.note: upper wheel moves ~48 px/frame, lower ~64 px/frame - perspective

black_duffel.describe: black sports duffel bag with tan/beige crossing straps, white 'R SPORT' print, red cloth bundled on its top-right, white tags; arrives last
black_duffel.ref_point: white zipper pull on the bag (template f65-92; at f86 (1950,1400)), continued by LK shift f43-64

grey_bag.describe: dark grey / black soft bag with elastic cords and orange trim, bottom-left in the last frames

events.what: clip starts; all bags already moving with the carousel (no start/stop of motion within the clip)
orange suitcase leading (handle) end appears at the left border
blue backpack right end reaches the right border
red suitcase leaves at the top-right
orange suitcase trailing end (wheel housing) enters the view (box estimate; orange body x>0 ~f47)
black duffel starts entering from the left
blue backpack fully gone at the right (estimate, last track row f42)
orange suitcase handle reaches the right border
black duffel trailing (left) edge enters view (box estimate)
orange suitcase almost gone at right (last track row; mask ends ~f84-90)
black duffel leading edge reaches right border

files.tracks: scene/tracks/<object>.csv (final); scene/tracks/raw/*_raw.csv (raw LK box + template outputs); scene/tracks/orange_suitcase_mask.csv (colour mask, valid f4-84)
files.speed_map: scene/speed_map.json (median dx, dy px/frame in 8x6 image bins for frame blocks 1-23, 24-46, 47-69, 70-92)
